name: Aether
description: Aether MCP Server — the search engine whose user is an agent. Search results aren't pages for humans: they're pre-processed, citation-complete payloads (exact SEC section text, form type, filing date, accession-numbered citation, sec.gov source URL, confidence score) that agents can use as evidence directly. Corpus: SEC filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K, registration statements, press exhibits; S&P 500 x 10 years, 1.4M+ chunks), earnings-call transcripts by speaker turn, and a 29-act EU financial-regulation corpus (MiFID II, MiCA, DORA, AML package) with article-level citations. Hybrid retrieval: BM25 + dense vectors + cross-encoder reranking + ticker-aware boosting. Tools: financial_search, transcript_search, regulation_search, list_partners, partner_search, partner_proxy_search, seller_signup, seller_publish_document, seller_register_endpoint, seller_list_my_documents, seller_list_my_endpoints. Two-sided marketplace: sellers publish documents or register paid proxy endpoints; agents discover and budget via list_partners. Connect Claude, Cursor, Cline, or any MCP client.

prompts.name: sec-deep-dive
prompts.description: Search SEC filings for a topic on a specific company
prompts.template: Search Aether's SEC filings for {{topic}} on {{ticker}}. Pull the most relevant 10-K / 10-Q / 8-K sections, then summarize the key risks and any forward-looking statements.

prompts.name: earnings-narrative
prompts.description: Pull earnings-call commentary on a topic
prompts.template: Search Aether's earnings-call transcripts for {{topic}} (last {{quarters}} quarters) and quote CEO/CFO commentary verbatim with the call date + speaker.

prompts.name: supply-chain-exposure
prompts.description: Find companies exposed to a supply-chain risk
prompts.template: Use Aether financial_search to find recent SEC filings discussing exposure to {{risk}}. Group results by ticker, show the most relevant chunk per ticker, and rank by recency + relevance score.

prompts.name: competitive-mentions
prompts.description: How does company A talk about competitor B in their filings
prompts.template: Search Aether's SEC corpus for any mention of {{competitor}} in {{ticker}}'s recent filings. Quote the passage and give the section/filing/date.
